za_notes: The only allowed additions are these 46 forms already supported by ZA_PATCH, plus existing Floette/Zygarde legacy filename aliases.
Retromc fronts take priority; Aronousqui20 supplies available backs, with retromc Dragonite back. Essentials fills the explicitly listed missing sides/forms.
Greninja uses the canonical -front.gif; the alternate -front2.gif is not selected.
Artist GIFs are copied without resizing, recoloring, or changing their frame timings.
